description: Change part of a theme file or .entities document in a Fudge draft by replacing exact text, without line gutters. Fudge validates the result and refreshes the preview.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence. Defaults to false.

path.description: A theme file such as sections/main-product.liquid or templates/product.json, or a content document such as .entities/product/123.jsonc or .entities/page/45.body.html.

revision.description: The revision returned when this file was read.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: edit_draft_file
title: Edit draft file
